title: 企业收缩办公面积
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Wide shot of an East Asian company's office being downsized. Workers unplug several computers and stack empty chairs while a manager compares a smaller floor plan with the existing office. Half the room is already unused and staff continue working in a smaller area. No factory setting.
